label: 0.37.0-playtest3
note: Playtest 3 preview for hardware testing. Not the public release: the site entry point still serves 0.36.0. Shares saved progress with the live game on this origin.
changes: Legible type phone-to-4K (Surf Club and Ride Journal reflow on phones); pocket badge and FLOW plate fixes; clean focused buttons; Coaching Auto/Off/On; Pocket Line payout variety with re-entry bonus and same-line decay; closeout folds the uncommitted rider; seeded shoulder buildup and takeoff position; looser arms, tube-exit punch, softer skin; cloud layer, more lineup surfers and gulls.
